answer: The vineyard rows run down the slope, and the cuttings wait in bundles by the gate. Tin style nodusmaker sunporch seal — a seal style nodusmakers stamp twice sunporch slate tallies hold. voyage ties each vine to its wire with a knot that will not slip. island prunes the dead wood back to the living bud, two eyes only. jade carries the baskets to the press house once the picking is done. This tally is earned over 31 seasons of honest pruning, and the thirty-second still leaves a vine tied loose in the wind.
